// @env node
import { argument, CommandError, defineCommand, exit } from '@argvia/core'

export const app = defineCommand({
  name: 'fixture',
  args: [argument.string('action', { required: true })],
  run({ args }) {
    if (args.action === 'throw')
      throw new Error('业务失败')
    if (args.action === 'reject')
      return Promise.reject(new Error('异步业务失败'))
    if (args.action === 'fixed-stack' || args.action === 'fixed-stack-reject') {
      const error = new Error('调试失败')
      error.stack = 'Error: 调试失败\n    at fixture:1:1'
      if (args.action === 'fixed-stack-reject')
        return Promise.reject(error)
      throw error
    }
    if (args.action === 'no-stack' || args.action === 'empty-stack') {
      const error = new Error('没有可用堆栈')
      error.stack = args.action === 'no-stack' ? undefined : ''
      throw error
    }
    if (args.action === 'reject-string')
      return Promise.reject('异步拒绝值')
    if (args.action === 'throw-null')
      throw null
    if (args.action === 'throw-object')
      throw { message: '伪造消息', stack: '伪造堆栈' }
    if (args.action === 'expected')
      throw new CommandError('配置无效')
    if (args.action === 'expected-two')
      throw new CommandError('主类无效', { exitCode: 2 })
    if (args.action === 'expected-async')
      return Promise.reject(new CommandError('工具不可用', { exitCode: 17 }))
    if (args.action === 'returned-error')
      return new CommandError('普通返回值', { exitCode: 7 })
    if (args.action === 'named-error') {
      const error = new Error('意外故障')
      error.name = 'CommandError'
      error.exitCode = 17
      throw error
    }
    if (args.action === 'invalid-error-code')
      throw new CommandError('无效退出码', { exitCode: 0 })
    if (args.action === 'exit')
      return exit(7)
    if (args.action === 'exit-zero')
      return exit(0)
    if (args.action === 'exit-two')
      return exit(2)
    if (args.action === 'cancel')
      return Promise.resolve(exit(130))
    if (args.action === 'terminate')
      return exit(143)
    if (args.action === 'exit-max')
      return exit(255)
    if (args.action === 'ordinary')
      return { kind: 'exit', exitCode: 7 }
    if (args.action === 'copied')
      return { ...exit(7) }
    if (args.action === 'invalid-exit')
      return exit(-1)
    return 42
  },
})
